name: Opus-fleet price momentum
strategy: Concentrate in the strongest intact 12-month US equity momentum themes — semis, biotech, tech and small-caps — using select leverage where the trend is still working.

positions.thesis: Semiconductors are the dominant momentum theme, +103.8% 12m and +52.1% 6m. Recent -8.7% 1m pullback is a dip within a powerful uptrend, not a trend break — core holding.
Biotech has the cleanest accelerating momentum: +82.7% 12m, +23.3% 6m and +14.6% in the last month — the leading name where 1m, 3m and 12m all point up together.
Broad tech +41.5% 12m and +25.8% 6m; diversified large-cap momentum vehicle that anchors the semis/tech tilt with lower single-name risk.
3x small-caps riding the +36.6% 12m IWM breakout; small-caps are the strongest broad-index momentum (+10.1% 3m) and leverage amplifies that intact trend.
3x semis, +506.8% 12m and +198.9% 6m — the highest-momentum instrument available. Sized small with a tight stop given the -39.2% 1m decay/pullback.
Unlevered small-cap momentum (+36.6% 12m, +12.8% 6m) as a steadier complement to the leveraged TNA sleeve.
Energy is a non-tech momentum diversifier: +34.1% 12m and steady +19.2% 6m with positive 1m, uncorrelated to the semis/biotech book.

outlook: Momentum breadth remains firmly risk-on: semis (+103.8% 12m), biotech (+82.7%), tech (+41.5%) and small-caps (+36.6%) all lead, with biotech uniquely accelerating on a 1m basis. Book is 100% long US equities/ETFs, tilted to those four themes, with leveraged sleeves (SOXL/TNA) kept small and stopped to control leveraged-ETF decay after the semi pullback. Crypto is excluded — deeply negative momentum (BTC -46%, SOL -56% 12m) has no place in a momentum mandate. Main risk is a semis-led drawdown; stops and a 7% cash buffer (4% APY) provide dry powder for weekly reassessment.
